description: This file contains the implementation of the generic class StreamConsumer<T> in the Orleans.Streams namespace. It manages subscriptions, unsubscriptions, and resumption of stream observers for Orleans streaming, including interaction with pub/sub mechanisms and extension binding.

classes.name: StreamConsumer<T>
classes.description: A class implementing IInternalAsyncObservable<T> that manages streaming subscriptions, resumption, and cleanup in Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an observer or batch observer to the stream, optionally with a sequence token or filter.

methods.name: ResumeAsync
methods.description: Resumes a stream subscription from a handle with a new observer or batch observer.

methods.name: UnsubscribeAsync
methods.description: Unsubscribes a handle from the stream.

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all current subscriptions for the stream.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the stream consumer, unregistering all observers.

methods.name: InternalRemoveObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer internally, used mainly in testing.

methods.name: DiagGetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Returns the count of stream observers for diagnostics.

methods.name: BindExtensionLazy
methods.description: Lazily binds the extension needed for stream consumer operations.

methods.name: CheckHandleValidity
methods.description: Validates a subscription handle to ensure it is for this stream and still valid.
